basic_info.main_problem: 我一直觉得因为自己的喜好和过往经历,我without法融入他人,这让我Feels isolated和难过.
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到持续的Loneliness感已经影响到我的日常生活和心理健康,因此决定寻求咨询.
growth_experiences: 约一年前与前Male友分手,此后开始持续感到Being rejected与not被接纳,认为自己without法融入他人.为避免再次受伤,逐渐回避Social gatherings与新关系尝试,尽管尝试用兴趣爱好分散注意力,但情绪仍反复出现并持续.随着时间推移,求职Decreased drive,日常作息与自我照料习惯受到影响;Living alone且社交支持薄弱进一步加重了Loneliness与悲伤.
上个月尝试加入读书会,在现场自觉被他人评判并提前离场,not yet再返回.虽然现场有人主动邀请其参与对话,但因Anxiety而not yet能投入,这一经历进一步Reinforcement了其'我not被接纳/not合群'的信念.

special_situations.event: 与他人存在偏好差异(例如颜色喜好not同)时参与社交
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我与他人not同,就意味着我not会被接纳
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前退出或直接避免参与相关社交活动以降低Being rejected风险

special_situations.event: When joining a book club, notices others looking at oneself or moments of quiet
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人看我或have not明确的热情回应,就表示他们在评判并not欢迎我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少互动,提前离场,之后not再参加该活动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得I am strange,not想让我在场

special_situations.event: Meeting new people or trying to build new relationships
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再次Being rejected,我会承受not了,因此最好not要开始
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避Meeting new friends,停留在熟悉环境与Being alone状态

special_situations.event: 回想与前Male友的分手及其后的孤立经历
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果过去Being rejected过,说明我not值得被接纳,not yet来也会一直如此
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用兴趣爱好分散注意但not主动社交,以减少再次受挫的可能

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and to build stable, intimate connections with others
core_conflict.fear: 害怕再次遭到拒绝与评判,担心自我价值被negate
defense_goal: Lowers the risk of being hurt and maintains a sense of safety through distance and avoidance

object_relations.self_representation: Being rejected的局外人,容易被评判的人
在社交中紧张而not被欢迎的参与者
object_relations.object_representation: 群体是潜在的拒绝者,表面友好但内在not接受

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师Demands对'被评判/not被接纳'的信念提供具体证据,或提出not同Interpretation时(如讨论读书会的实际互动)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内在的Being rejectedFear视为外界真实判断,认为他人(包括群体)在评判自己(移情:将Self-denialProjection到他人)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和,以Empathy为主;先承认其感受的合理性,再以好奇探询区分'感觉'与'证据',邀请举具体事实并进行现实检验,避免直接negate其体验.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about whether to return to the book club or try new social opportunities
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 强调'避免更安全'以为回避辩护,将Withdrawal视为理性选择而非Fear驱动(移情:将咨询师的邀请体验为潜在风险)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 先Empathy其对安全与掌控的需求,再以温柔的挑战提出小步尝试的替代方案;use具体化,正反证问题与协作式目标设定,保持支持与鼓励的语气.

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance(在Social situations提前离场,停留在家中,not参加聚会或新关系尝试)
antecedent: Meeting new people or trying to build connections
Participating in group activities (e.g. book clubs)
target_behavior.core_reason: 分手后形成的'我not会被接纳'的核心信念与认知歪曲(读心术,预测not yet来,过度概括),伴随对再次Being rejected的强烈Fear.
target_behavior.function: 逃避Being rejected与Anxietynot适,短期维持主观安全感与控制感.
target_behavior.consequence: 持续Loneliness与悲伤,Reduced social support,进一步Reinforcement负性信念并影响心理健康.

target_behavior.behavior: Low motivation and avoidance in job-seeking
antecedent: Facing job-seeking tasks (preparing resume, applying, interviews)
Thinking about needing to meet new people or be evaluated
target_behavior.core_reason: 孤立与负性情绪降低动机,同时担心not被接受或失败,倾向灾难化与Rationalization回避.
target_behavior.function: 逃避失败与负面评价,减轻短期压力与Anxiety.
target_behavior.consequence: 持续Unemployment,生活功能与自我照料进一步受损.

target_behavior.behavior: Self-care declines (daily routines and self-care habits are affected)
target_behavior.core_reason: 负性情绪与Meaninglessness感降低能量与主动性,回避成为主要Coping strategies.
target_behavior.function: Temporarily reduces external demands and self-imposed burdens to avoid further emotional fluctuations.
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased quality of life,身心状态恶化,难以Recovery积极的社会参与.
